build_dinov2_wrapper: build a python module to extract DINOv2 vision features from input images using DinoV2Wrapper
create_vision_transformer: create a DinoVisionTransformer model with configurable patch size, depth, and number of attention heads
run_vit_model_constructor: run a vit_small, vit_base, vit_large, or vit_giant2 factory function to instantiate a DINOv2 model
test_patch_embed: test the PatchEmbed module to convert 2D images into patch token embeddings of shape BxNxD
review_dino_head: review the DINOHead class and its MLP bottleneck architecture for self-supervised contrastive learning
